title: Tags de Dano e Combate — proposta integral provisória da p. 92
scopeLimits: All 30 text-bearing editorial blocks on p.92 are represented. Formal Tag names remain source identifiers. Twelve vector groups owned by editorial text are semantic inline elements; fixed page flourish, header/footer and background artwork remain intact.
Source-PDF visual-line counts are grouped by measured baselines. All revised PT-BR candidates remain UNMEASURED until measured in the real PageRenderer Copyfit V3.
Ambiguous mechanics and unconfirmed reference titles are retained in pendingTerms; no candidate is approved or written to the final Payload.

COLOSSAL:
A figure with this Tag ignores Elevation and other figures when drawing
Line of Sight and figures targeting a figure with this Tag ignore Elevation
and other figures when drawing Line of Sight.

be occupying spaces beneath a figure's base onto the nearest unoccupied
space to the figure that Displaced them. Placing figures in this way does
not count as movement, ignores HEAVY and HULKING, and does not
provoke Break Attacks. If the space a figure is placed onto is Dangerous
Terrain, that figure may immediately Jump to the nearest Non-Dangerous
unoccupied space.

candidates.sourceText:
FLIGHT:
A figure with FLIGHT ignores the effects of all Terrain they occupy. While
moving, figures with FLIGHT ignore other figures and only provoke Break
Attacks from opponents who were adjacent to them at the start of the
Move Action or the Ability that gave them FLIGHT. Figures with FLIGHT
do not ignore Obstructing Terrain. A figure with FLIGHT may not end their
movement in a space occupied by another figure. Figures with FLIGHT
may draw Line of Sight and move between any Elevation change without
penalty.
candidates.proposalText:
FLIGHT:
Uma miniatura com FLIGHT ignora os efeitos de todo Terreno que ocupe. Enquanto se move, miniaturas com FLIGHT ignoram outras miniaturas e só provocam Break Attacks de oponentes que estivessem adjacentes a elas no início da Ação de Movimento ou da Habilidade que lhes concedeu FLIGHT. Miniaturas com FLIGHT não ignoram Terreno Obstruído. Uma miniatura com FLIGHT não pode terminar seu movimento em um espaço ocupado por outra miniatura. Miniaturas com FLIGHT podem traçar Linha de Visão e mover-se entre quaisquer mudanças de Elevação sem penalidade.
